periods.time: vol-10 ch-002, end of the waiting-room incident

name.zh: 史黛菈阻止天音玷污珠雫的心意
name.en: Stella stops Amane from violating Shizuku's feelings

periods.summary: After defeating Shizuku, Amane uses the broadcast to describe Shizuku's love for Ikki in degrading terms and suggests Ikki should accept her as a woman. Shizuku, pinned and unable to speak, begs him to stop. Stella blasts through the wall, tells Amane to shut up, and warns that she will burn him to charcoal if he continues defiling Shizuku's feelings. She releases Shizuku from the wall and catches her as she loses consciousness.
periods.cause: Amane tries to wound Ikki and Shizuku by publicly twisting Shizuku's private feelings.
periods.outcome: Amane's verbal humiliation stops, Shizuku is rescued alive, and Stella and Shizuku's rival-sister bond deepens.
periods.significance: Shows Stella protecting Shizuku's dignity despite romantic rivalry, and gives Ikki the gratitude he later expresses to Stella.
